findings: Fresh opening has no new enrollment or event UI. Enrollment derives invitations; Events toggles them with native messages. Links open the right Notebook panel; focus survives countdown ticks and reload restores one card without rewards.
The normal Attend action grants real route understanding once. Events removes its invitation and derives the known aftermath; native export/import retains both without re-awarding it.
A missed briefing advertises an available report after its delay; its actual aftermath appears only after the player hears it.
A real material-funded craftsman commission finishes independently. Its local ready card opens collection; actual kit ownership and card removal survive reload without duplicate rewards.
A public shower appears from the shared scheduler. Events links to the existing response controls; letting the bench dry changes actual saved workshop conditions and resolves the card.
scope: Read-only integration of existing Events, Notebook and saved outcomes; broader event content remains future authoring.
